audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers read Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Skill/Lucian while the packet chart reads Lucian/Skill/Skill/Akali/Akali/Akali/Akali and the page's own whys say she pulls ahead from 4-5 onward.
audit.why: 39.39% over 33 games plus every why-string from index 3 up describing an Akali win means the rows shipped contradicting the prose beside them.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 rewritten to the packet chart as matched full/content pairs, with ratings pulled down to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first item were written as Lucian spikes.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s with two dashes and an execute; her first AP item makes Twilight Shroud into R a single-rotation kill on Lucian's base HP.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item now read as Akali spikes; Lucian's spikes stay at levels 1-3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twilight Shroud and Shuriken Flip were named but never given numbers, and Assassin's Mark's auto reset was absent.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and makes her unselectable by spells and attacks; Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1 and is her gap-closer; Assassin's Mark empowers her next attack when you leave the ring her spell damage creates.
audit.corrected: Shroud's 20s and Shuriken Flip's 16s now anchor the trade advice, and the Assassin's Mark wind-up tell replaced a generic don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Lucian's W reveal defeats Twilight Shroud is not answerable from the kit text.
audit.why: W reveals enemies; Shroud grants invisibility plus unselectability. Riot's text does not settle whether the reveal restores targeting.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: E online, but Twilight Shroud (20s) unselects her mid-string — trade only once it is spent.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Full kit chunks her, but Shuriken Flip (16s) trades back and Shroud resets it — go on her cooldowns, not yours.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Twilight Shroud — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Shuriken Flip gives her a gap-closer you cannot match and Shroud resets her trades — hold E as your exit, never as an entry.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's two dashes leave The Culling channel and execute your low HP — she owns 6.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Her first AP item makes Shroud-into-R a one-rotation kill — your window shut at level 3, so farm safe and roam instead.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: She out-scales hard — at 2+ items her burst out of Shroud deletes you, so play with the team and never face-check the smoke.

edits.before: That’s Akali’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Her Assassin's Mark auto lands when you exit the ring — step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: The chart below maps the swing points — neither side owns this lane until a spike says so.
edits.after: You own Level 1 and lose the lane from 4 onward — the rows below say exactly when.

notes: Chart aligned to the packet across both layers as matched pairs; the previous rows disagreed with the whys printed next to them. No claim made about W's reveal versus Twilight Shroud's unselectability — not answerable from Riot's text.
